headline: Energy bills are soaring. How much more household consumers could pay this winter
summary: Romanians could see significantly higher energy bills this winter and in spring 2027, a state secretary at the energy ministry warned. Extremely low Danube flows are cited among the pressures on the energy system.
why: Energy prices and system adequacy affect household spending, inflation and the cost base of Romanian businesses. Romania's energy sector is a significant part of its economy.
